documentation_paragraph: Configuration integration on `47bafbd` now passes eight distinct affected roots and ten named RUN=PASS nodes in two bounded race cohorts: six startup/accounting roots with eight nodes, followed by the configured-source join/storage-debt and configuration settled-proof roots. Targeted Manager/CLI/database vet also passes. The fifteen owned inputs remain unchanged across execution; fourteen match the original guarded feature and only the shared Manager integration differs. This closes the scoped configuration integration gate while preserving the original 117-node and earlier composition evidence. It does not establish Linux configuration runtime, services, live reload, full degraded-database recovery, provider activation, retention/restore or whole-suite acceptance.
